title: Classification of Generalised Triorthogonal Codes through Length 54
summary: Magic state distillation is a widely considered primitive in fault-tolerant quantum computation for the preparation of high-fidelity non-Clifford resources. The most commonly considered class of such protocols are generalised triorthogonal codes; these distil $n$ noisy input $\mathrm{T}$ states into purified third-level diagonal magic states. Extensive prior work has searched this space of protocols, often using heuristic methods that do not guarantee optimality.
